name: OpenClaw
tagline: The OpenClaw assistant on your own model and Telegram bot in minutes, with a volume so it remembers you across restarts.
description: OpenClaw (formerly Clawdbot) is an open-source AI assistant with a web Control UI, chat channels and tools that act on its own machine. Deploying it adds a persistent volume, so its workspace, memory, chats, paired browsers and Telegram approvals survive restarts and redeploys. Untick the volume and it runs as a sandbox that starts fresh on every restart, for experiments and throwaway tasks. Either way its settings come back from your environment variables, so it always starts configured. Set an Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter or xAI key, open the app and enter the gateway token to connect your browser as the owner. It stays locked: the gateway requires its token, every browser has to be paired, and strangers who find your Telegram bot get nowhere without your approval. The agent's shell commands run inside the app's own container. Needs an always-on plan with 2 GB of memory. You bring the model key, and the provider bills the tokens.
